scientific_integrity: All-parameter analytic proof, with exact rational and independent LP checks as finite corroboration; no independent audit or external mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for scalar-linear one-point extension from equilateral finite metrics with arbitrary metric-admissible positive radii. Does not establish an arbitrary-base, multi-point or general Banach-target theorem; generic finite-dimensional LP methods and homogeneous-radius results are prior work. Historical formulations may be overlooked.
title: Water-filling and signed-optimizer transitions for equilateral one-point Lipschitz extensions
